method: Read HEAD source only. No assumption that the old roadmap still represents the code. Every claim cites a file:line verified in this worktree.
headline_finding: About half of the selective-pipeline primitives ALREADY EXIST and are correct: two full output profiles (automatic/professional_qc) with UI + env propagation, an end-to-end download-only mode (0 OCR/translate/clean/typeset/YK), a translation kill-switch (translation_enabled) that provably skips the provider and YK, a per-run artifact manifest, and output_format (pdf/png/psd). The genuine gaps are (1) NO unifying OutputPlan contract - the knobs are scattered independent booleans; (2) the two named presets that need the render step decoupled (translate-only-data, translate+clean-without-typeset) do not exist; (3) 'Apenas Clean' exists only as a dev kill-switch, not a product mode; (4) no UI presets beyond download-only + the two profiles; (5) the manifest records a profile-derived artifact set, not a requested_outputs/effective_operations contract.

key_execution_facts.pipeline_entry: yomu/pipeline/benchmark_pipeline.py::run_benchmark (line 1659); spawned as a child of yomu/runtime/job_runner.py which passes env.
key_execution_facts.render_couples_clean_and_typeset: render_analyzed_image typesets translated text AND captures the cleaned background in the same pass (benchmark_pipeline.py ~2675, cleaned_capture). CLEAN is a by-product of the render/typeset stage, not an independent stage today.
key_execution_facts.translation_gate: translation_enabled (env TRANSLATION_ENABLED, benchmark_pipeline.py:2021) hard-gates the provider boundary: when false -> 'PROVIDER_GATE_CHECKED translation_enabled=false', translations=['']*n, no provider init, no YK commit (benchmark_pipeline.py:2515-2528).
key_execution_facts.yk_commit_point: YK is committed exactly once, only when translation_enabled AND translation_targets AND commit_translation callable (benchmark_pipeline.py:2633-2636). download_only and translation-disabled runs commit 0 YK.
key_execution_facts.config_normalization_chokepoint: yomu/ui/ui_bridge.py::UiBridge._normalize_payload (line 7237) is the single server-side place that sanitizes download_only / output_profile / output_format / translation_enabled into the job configuration dict.
key_execution_facts.clean_only_is_latent: translation_enabled=false already yields OCR + text-erased (clean) pages with 0 provider/0 YK. It is a kill-switch for OCR-only/testing, NOT surfaced as a user 'Apenas Clean' product mode, still typesets empty strings + builds a PDF, and persists as translated_image rather than clean_image.

capabilities.evidence: OutputProfile.AUTOMATIC -> (final_pdf, translated_image); artifact_contract.py:68-76; UI radio automatic (static/tradutor_ui.js:1309); env propagation job_runner._set_output_profile_environment:56.
capabilities.gap: None. This preset maps 1:1 to the existing automatic profile.

capabilities.evidence: OutputProfile.PROFESSIONAL_QC -> final_pdf+translated_image+clean_image+editable_psd+quality_report+review_manifest; artifact_contract.py:72-75. UI radio professional_qc; psd gated to professional (tradutor_ui.js:1335).

download_only threaded through commands/run_webtoon.py, review/source_readiness.py, runtime/job_runner.py:835-1010, job_completion.py:53; UI #modeSelect option value='download_only' (tradutor_ui.js:1123); forces output_profile=automatic (ui_bridge _normalize_payload:7258).
capabilities.gap: Exists but is modeled as a separate processing-mode, not as one option in a unified output-plan. Reuse as-is.

capabilities.evidence: translation_enabled fail-closed (ui_bridge:7269); env TRANSLATION_ENABLED (job_runner:724); hard provider gate + no YK commit (benchmark_pipeline.py:2515-2528, 2633).
capabilities.gap: It is the primitive that makes CLEAN-only cost 0 provider/0 YK. Not itself a product mode.

capabilities.capability: Preset 'Apenas Clean' (clean images only, no translation, 0 provider/0 YK)
capabilities.evidence: Latent via translation_enabled=false (produces text-erased pages, 0 provider/0 YK). But: not exposed in UI; still typesets empty + builds PDF; persists result as translated_image not clean_image; no requested-outputs marker.
capabilities.gap: Needs: a product mode that sets translation off, persists the pages as CLEAN_IMAGE, and marks typeset/pdf as NOT_REQUESTED. Achievable on existing primitives (no deep render rewrite).

capabilities.capability: Preset 'Apenas traducao' (translation data only, no clean/typeset/images)
capabilities.evidence: No path skips render entirely. run_benchmark always renders when not download_only. Translation text is produced but there is no 'emit translation manifest and stop' output.
capabilities.gap: Needs a skip-render path emitting a translation manifest artifact. Real pipeline change (medium).

capabilities.capability: Preset 'Traducao + Clean' (translate + clean, NO typeset burn)
capabilities.evidence: render_analyzed_image couples clean capture and text burn-in in one pass (~2675). There is no flag to clean + produce translation data without burning text onto the image.
capabilities.gap: Needs render decoupled: clean-without-burn while translation is enabled. Real pipeline change (medium/high).

capabilities.evidence: No custom operation selector in UI; no contract to validate an arbitrary combination.
capabilities.gap: Needs the OutputPlan contract (below) + a UI custom selector.

capabilities.capability: Unified OutputPlan / ProcessingPlan DTO (single source of truth)
capabilities.evidence: Selective behaviour is scattered across independent booleans (download_only, translation_enabled, output_profile, output_format) resolved ad hoc in _normalize_payload:7247-7302. No normalize_output_plan(), no operation enumeration.
capabilities.gap: Core gap. Build yomu/runtime/output_plan.py: presets + operations {TRANSLATE,CLEAN,TYPESET,PDF,PSD,QC} + normalize_output_plan() with dependency rules, mapping each plan onto the EXISTING knobs so all proven plumbing is reused.

capabilities.evidence: Some implicit guards exist: psd requires professional_qc (ui_bridge:7261), download_only forces automatic (7258). But there is no explicit operation dependency graph; invalid combinations are only partially caught.
capabilities.gap: Centralize all dependency rules in normalize_output_plan().

capabilities.evidence: build_artifact_manifest records requested_artifacts derived from the profile only (artifact_contract.py:219-243). No field states which operations the USER asked for vs which actually ran.
capabilities.gap: Add requested_outputs + effective_operations to the manifest so retry/re-export and the finish screen can filter truthfully.

capabilities.capability: Retry / re-export reuses persisted translation (0 extra provider/YK)
capabilities.evidence: YK contract from prior missions: translation persisted on success, re-export reuses it; YK committed once at 2633. Settlement provider returns None for download-only/non-YK (job_runner:116-127).
capabilities.gap: No change needed; new modes must not regress it (covered by a spy test).

capabilities.capability: Finish-screen filtering by requested outputs / NOT_REQUESTED semantics
capabilities.evidence: Finish/completion keys off output_profile + output_format + download_only (ui_bridge _job_record:893-903, job_completion.py). Action buttons shown by profile (tradutor_ui.js:100). No per-operation 'nao solicitado' state.
capabilities.gap: Finish screen must show only requested artifacts and mark the rest NOT_REQUESTED (not FAILED/missing).

capabilities.capability: Provider-agnostic CLEAN (abstract capability, no gemini/oracle/chrome branching)
capabilities.evidence: CLEAN today is the local render cleanup (render_analyzed_image). No provider branching for clean exists anywhere in UI/output planning. yomu/clean package exists as the home for clean logic.
capabilities.gap: Keep it abstract: the output plan must express CLEAN as one operation with no provider conditionals, so a future remote clean (Gemini/VPS, Codex line) swaps the implementation without touching the plan/UI.

capabilities.evidence: Progress aggregation is per-page render (benchmark_pipeline PageProgressAggregator:2642). Stages are not reported as requested/not-requested.
capabilities.gap: When a stage is not in the plan, progress should mark it NOT_REQUESTED rather than 0%/stuck.

build_this_mission: yomu/runtime/output_plan.py: presets + operations + normalize_output_plan() with dependency rules, mapping to existing knobs (provider-agnostic CLEAN).
Execute the presets that map onto existing primitives truthfully (Traducao pronta=automatic, Profissional=professional_qc, Apenas Clean=translation-off+clean-persist, Download=download_only).
scoped_followups_not_faked: Apenas traducao (skip-render + translation-manifest output): needs a real pipeline path; will be marked contract-defined, execution PLANNED - NOT reported as implemented.
Traducao + Clean without typeset burn: needs render decoupled; contract-defined, execution PLANNED.
Full UI preset surface + custom selector + finish-screen NOT_REQUESTED: needs design-system reuse + browser verification.
implementation_decision.honesty_rule: No preset will be reported IMPLEMENTED unless its execution is wired and test-proven on this HEAD. Contract-only presets are labelled PLANNED.
